quality_finding: Structurally correct, factually degraded. The source headline said the companies face an antitrust suit for agreeing to SLOW AI development; the model wrote that they had agreed to STOP it, and added a motive ('auf Sicherheitsgruende hin') that is not in the source. The 'Darum geht's dich an' line was content-free. Nothing checkable was invented - no numbers, no unknown item id, no link - so the validator passed it. This is finding F9 with a concrete example on the first real run.
